summary.text: Steve Livingston, a Republican, has represented District 8 in the Alabama State Senate since November 2014 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists him as Alabama State Senate Majority Leader since October 31, 2023.
He graduated from Scottsboro High School and the University of Alabama, and his professional experience includes owning and managing Dicus Oil Company.
